key.name: active
key.description: Remembered across restarts. Turned on automatically when MultiZoom takes over from the built-in magnifier.

key.name: default-zoom
key.description: Zoom level a monitor gets the first time MultiZoom sees it.

key.name: zoom-step
key.description: Factor each zoom-in or zoom-out shortcut multiplies or divides the zoom by.

key.name: zoom-in
key.summary: Zoom in on the monitor under the pointer

key.name: zoom-out
key.summary: Zoom out on the monitor under the pointer

key.name: toggle-lock
key.summary: Lock or unlock the view on the monitor under the pointer
key.description: A locked view stays where it is: it no longer follows the pointer, even when the pointer is on that monitor.
